src: Nenu repu college ki vastanu but assignment complete cheyyaledu
ref: I will come to college tomorrow but I have not completed the assignment.

src: Meeru ee project deadline gurinchi manager tho matladara?
ref: Did you talk to the manager about this project deadline?

src: Ninna night nenu movie chusanu chala bagundi
ref: Last night I watched a movie it was very good.

src: Exam ki prepare avvadaniki naku inka time kavali
ref: I need more time to prepare for the exam.

src: Mee dagara charger undha?
ref: Do you have a charger with you?

src: Nenu ippudu lab lo unnanu call chey later
ref: I am in the lab now call me later.

src: Ee weekend trip ki evaru evaru vastunnaru?
ref: Who all are coming on this weekend trip?

src: Class cancel ayyindi ani professor chepparu
ref: The professor said the class got cancelled.

src: Naaku ee concept ardham kaaledu can you explain again?
ref: I did not understand this concept can you explain again?

src: Lunch ki canteen ki veldam
ref: Let us go to the canteen for lunch.

src: Kal meeting hai please slides bhej dena
ref: There is a meeting tomorrow please send the slides.

src: Mujhe assignment submit karna hai but internet nahi chal raha
ref: I have to submit the assignment but the internet is not working.

src: Tum kab tak college aaoge?
ref: By when will you come to college?

src: Yaar exam ki preparation bilkul nahi hui
ref: Man I have not prepared for the exam at all.

src: Aaj ka lecture bahut boring tha
ref: Today's lecture was very boring.

src: Main canteen ja raha hoon tum bhi aao
ref: I am going to the canteen you come too.

src: Project ka deadline kal hai jaldi code complete karo
ref: The project deadline is tomorrow complete the code quickly.

src: Mera laptop hang ho gaya hai
ref: My laptop has hung.

src: Kya tumne notes share kiye?
ref: Did you share the notes?

src: Weekend pe trip plan karte hain
ref: Let us plan a trip for the weekend.
